passage: Kalyani sat on the charpai in the courtyard, feeding the newborn while her two-year-old son Rituraj hovered at the edge, thumb in his mouth. All morning Rituraj had heard only "good helper, well done." Now Kalyani patted the space beside her and pulled him up. "You're still my big boy, always," she said, and tucked his head under her chin. "There's room in my lap for both of you." Rituraj let out a long breath, took his thumb out, and stayed, watching the baby's tiny fist.

qa.q: Where was Kalyani sitting while she fed the newborn?
qa.a: Kalyani was sitting on the charpai in the courtyard.

qa.q: What was Rituraj probably feeling when he let out a long breath in his mother's lap?
qa.a: He probably felt relief and safety, sensing that his mother's love had not been used up by the baby. 🙂

qa.q: Why did the words and the lap help more than being called a good helper?
qa.a: Praise for helping only speaks to what he does, while being held and told he is always her big boy tells him he is loved for himself.

qa.q: How might Kalyani have felt, sitting between a newborn and an anxious toddler?
qa.a: She may have felt pulled two ways and wanted both children to know they had a place with her.

grounding: Shows a toddler being cuddled and told he is still his mother's big boy after a new baby arrives, so love feels secure.

passage:
Monday. Visitors praised baby Hrithik. Tenzin, two, hid under the table.

Thursday. After everyone left, Mama pulled Tenzin onto her lap and hugged him tight. "You're still my big boy. I love you so much." Tenzin pressed his face into her shoulder.

Two weeks later. When the baby cried, Tenzin ran to Mama, got a quick cuddle and said, "Still big boy." Then he went back to his trains.

qa.q: Where did Tenzin hide on Monday?
What was Tenzin feeling while visitors praised the baby?
qa.a: Tenzin felt left out and unsure whether there was still love for him.
She said them while cuddling him on her lap, so he felt love, not just praise for helping.

qa.q: How might baby Hrithik be affected as Tenzin feels secure again?
qa.a: Hrithik is likely to have a calmer older brother who doesn't need to compete as much.

grounding: Shows an older toddler reassured by words plus a lap that love has not been used up after a new baby.

passage:
The new baby cried all evening in the Kochi house. Rafiq, three, sat alone on the step, picking at his sandal.

His father, Vijay, came out and sat beside him. He lifted Rafiq onto his knees and held him close.

"Rafiq, you're still my big boy. My first boy. There's lots of love for you."

Rafiq leaned back against his chest. They watched the crows together until dinner.

qa.q: What were Rafiq and Vijay watching together?
What does Rafiq sitting alone and picking at his sandal suggest?
qa.a: It suggests Rafiq felt lonely and pushed aside by the attention on the new baby.

qa.q: How did Vijay help Rafiq feel secure?
qa.a: Vijay combined loving words with a lap and a long cuddle, showing love had not been used up.

qa.q: How might Vijay feel sitting with Rafiq on the step?
qa.a: Vijay likely feels tender and glad to give his older son some quiet time away from the busy house.

grounding: Shows an older toddler being cuddled and told he is still his father's big boy, which keeps him secure after a new baby.
